name: bb-plugin-pane-keeper
description: Cmd+N, notification clicks and drafts handed in from outside bb open beside the pane you're in, instead of over it.

bb.name: Pane Keeper
bb.description: With a split showing, Cmd+N and Notifications Pro clicks open a new pane to the right instead of replacing the one you're in. At 8 panes it swaps out the one you used least recently. `bb pane-keeper draft` opens New thread beside you with a prompt typed in and not sent.
